h1: Docker Compose Stack with Postgres, Redis, Nginx & Tools
includes: Postgres 16 with health checks and init scripts
Nginx reverse proxy with SSL-ready config
Adminer (database UI) — single file, no config
Custom bridge network with service discovery
Generated README with service URLs and env vars

faq.q: Is this for a specific application framework?
faq.a: No — it's a generic infrastructure stack. Use it as a base for any project needing Postgres, Redis, Nginx.
Nginx config is SSL-ready. Add certs to nginx/conf.d/ and update docker-compose.yml for production.

faq.q: Can I add my app service to this stack?
faq.a: Yes — add your service to docker-compose.yml and connect to the shared network. The README documents this.
The stack works for both. For production, remove Adminer/Mailpit, enable Watchtower, and use external secrets.
